notes: The song reaches animals too; the wolf den in the Briarwood and Juniper's silent-wolves worry. Juniper tells it in juniper-fenn.
text: Wolves let the sleepwalkers walk right through the pack. Didn't even look up.

followUp.text: Told you. Wolves and sleepwalkers, side by side. Juniper will say the same, and she was not pleased about it.
